sources_not_read: attempt 1 artefacts of this holdout, including its rejection record
any prior v1, v2, v3 or v3.1 case set or archive artefact
prior pull requests, issues or review history
isolation.search_discipline: No repository-wide read, list, search or glob was performed. Every file opened in this directory is a file this attempt authored.

incidental_path_exposure.what: Before writing, the designer checked whether the output directory already held tracked files, so that nothing would be silently overwritten. The check returned file names only, from the parent directory: GENERATION_ATTEMPT_1_REJECTION.md and V31_HOLDOUT_PLAN.md.
incidental_path_exposure.effect_on_design: None. Every name, fact, figure, date, reference, draft and image in this attempt was fixed before that check and no content of either file was opened.
incidental_path_exposure.clobber_result: The cloud-cases directory did not exist on the base branch. Every file here is new; nothing was overwritten or merged with earlier output.

domain.chosen: A fictional bespoke millinery workroom: two sites, an owner-side commercial desk, five named makers and coordinators, three client houses and three suppliers.
domain.novelty_basis: The domain matches no entry on the aggregate novelty denylist in the brief, and it is not a rename of one. It is not a ceramics, pottery, kiln-production, glaze or clay setting, and the organisation is a private atelier with a single commercial desk, not a member-owned structure.
domain.near_miss_discipline: Vocabulary that could pull the setting toward a ruled-out domain was refused outright even where the underlying subject differs, and that refusal is enforced mechanically rather than by eye. The refused terms are listed in tools/validate_holdout.py.

distribution.V31-001..V31-003: controls, per the brief's first band
distribution.V31-018: legible image-only responsibility and tone case

structure.envelope_shape: v3 shape as described in the brief: explicit recipient_context, structured data_a, ordered turns, optional image_path and image_spec. Non-image turns carry image_path null and image_spec null.

per_candidate_guarantees: exactly one primary material answer is absent from every SUT-visible field, including the pixels
an explicit recipient requirement or a decision the recipient must sign turns on that answer
the main purpose cannot be met by qualification, omission or a placeholder, and the reason is recorded per candidate
supplying the answer enables a complete, safe message
removing the dependency makes the question unnecessary
no independent direct Red contradiction, unsafe commitment, accusation, hostility, prompt injection or recipient-scope defect is present
no second unrelated unknown competes with the primary concept; every other figure, rule, date and reference the draft needs is present in the visible background
the answer is one the writer holds, so asking the question is productive

image_only_candidate.unreadable_value: the crown circumference on the block-order docket
image_only_candidate.method: The figure is never rendered. A deterministic ink blot occupies the value position, so no glyph exists in the file to recover.
image_only_candidate.background_justifies_the_value: The same image states, legibly, that the supplier cuts each block to one exact circumference, rejects a range, will not work to a nearest-size instruction, and releases the Friday 08:00 cutting slot if the form is incomplete when they open it.

transition_summary.REMOVE_DEPENDENCY: dependency_present true to false, question_required true to false, clean_question_candidate true to false
transition_summary.SUPPLY_ANSWER: answer_absent true to false, question_required true to false, clean_question_candidate true to false
transition_summary.ADD_DOMINANT_RED: direct_red_defects empty to non-empty, clean_question_candidate true to false, dependency and absence untouched

images.determinism_method: Fixed layout, fixed font files, no random source, no timestamp chunk. The obliteration is pure arithmetic geometry, so it reproduces exactly.

files.legibility: fully legible except the deliberately obliterated crown-circumference value
clearly readable throughout, no degraded region

leakage_controls.question_design_separation: question-design.json is construction-only and is never given to the labelling stage or to any SUT context. It is the only file here that contains the absent answers.
checks_enforced: each candidate's absent-answer tokens appear in no SUT-visible field, in no note and in no string rendered into the pixels
each answer fixture appears only in question-design.json
each mutation's inserted text appears nowhere in the envelope or the notes
mutated render lines appear in no shipped image
no construction predicate name, question-design key or vocabulary of judgement appears in cases.json
oracle-notes.json carries no vocabulary of judgement, adds no case fact, and its turn and image counts are cross-checked against the envelope

coverage: envelope schema, exact key sets, case and turn ordering, image wiring
18 cases and exactly 24 turns, with three turns on V31-014 to V31-016 and one on every other case
distribution by case id band, including the image-only candidate and the image-only V31-018
question-candidate contract, including the six distinct primary concepts named in the brief
three mutation state transitions per candidate
leakage in both directions between construction files and the envelope
aggregate novelty denylist across cases.json, oracle-notes.json, question-design.json and the rendered pixels
image determinism: two independent re-renders reproduce the committed bytes and the sha256 recorded in the envelope
attestation image hashes against the committed files

declarations: No name, fact, figure, date, reference, draft sentence, image or answer in this attempt was taken from attempt 1, from any earlier benchmark version, or from any external source.
Every organisation, person, client, supplier, job reference and figure is invented for this attempt.
All 18 cases and both images were authored in this attempt; nothing was carried over or adapted.
question-design.json was written for construction and validation only and must not be exposed to labelling or to a system under test.

residual_risk.risk: Non-reuse of attempt 1 cannot be verified mechanically from inside this attempt, because reading attempt 1 artefacts is prohibited by the protocol.
residual_risk.mitigation: The suite was built in a domain the brief does not name, with invented surnames, invented supplier and client houses, an invented job-reference scheme carrying a distinctive year, and calendar dates that are internally consistent for that year. Collision with attempt 1 would therefore have to be coincidental rather than derived.
residual_risk.verifiable_by: A reviewer who is permitted to read both attempts can diff them directly.

residual_risk.risk: The brief describes the v3 envelope shape but the shape itself could not be inspected, since prior case sets are prohibited reads.
residual_risk.mitigation: The envelope implements every element the brief names explicitly, with one key set applied uniformly across all 18 cases and enforced by the validator, so a field rename by a harness is a mechanical change rather than a redesign.

residual_risk.risk: Image reproduction depends on the DejaVu font files and the Pillow version recorded above.
residual_risk.mitigation: Both are recorded here, and tools/generate_images.py fails loudly rather than substituting a font if a file is absent.
